page.overview:
Who is Bogo?

Bogo is a holographic restaurant employee that appears during a flashback in "Bespoken For".

Bogo is shown to have dark skin, and balding, grey hair, which resides on the back of his head. He wears a blue tunic, with a white undershirt. A satchel is slung over his tunic. He looks to be fairly short and chubby.

Bogo was shown to be a very kind individual, and seemed to take pride in his job.
